text: use ordinary kriging: unknown constant mean, exponential spatial covariance independent observation noise. helper estimates covariance using observations passed . gstat estimates constant mean makes predictions. predictions use 259 training sites whichever CV scheme evaluated. observed target MSE average 100 measured squared errors. expectation repeated spatial datasets.
code: predict_ordinary <- function(train_xy, train_y, new_xy) {   fit <- estimate_covariance(train_xy, train_y)   observations <- data.frame(x = train_xy[, 1], y = train_xy[, 2], z = train_y)   new_points <- data.frame(x = new_xy[, 1], y = new_xy[, 2])   variogram <- gstat::vgm(psill = fit$psill, model = "Exp",                          range = fit$range, nugget = fit$nugget)   model <- gstat::gstat(formula = z ~ 1, locations = ~ x + y,                         data = observations, model = variogram)   stats::predict(model, newdata = new_points, debug.level = 0)$var1.pred }  target_predictions <- predict_ordinary(xy, y, qx) target_mse <- mean((observed_target - target_predictions)^2) target_mse #> [1] 0.3217736
